Across six rounds every file:line and behavioral claim in this document has now been re-derived against the tree at a reviewed commit; at b7deb948 I find zero unsupported claims, zero stale citations, and the three completeness-claim defects caught in rounds 3-5 (writer inventory, ModePlan trigger inventory, superseded-row set) are each corrected with the mechanism stated and, where drift-prone, mechanized by test obligation. APPROVE.
